nodes.label: PromptManager
nodes.rationale: Caches per-device system prompts and injects dynamic context (time, weather, location, external APIs) into the system prompt.

nodes.label: PromptManager.build_enhanced_prompt
nodes.rationale: Renders the base prompt template with Jinja2, substituting time, location, weather, language, emoji list, and dynamic context.

nodes.label: AudioRateController
nodes.rationale: Schedules 60ms audio frames against a virtual playhead to prevent timing drift during high-concurrency streaming.

nodes.label: OpusEncoderUtils
nodes.rationale: Stateful Opus encoder that buffers PCM samples and emits frames via callback for continuous TTS streaming.

nodes.label: Dialogue.get_llm_dialogue_with_memory
nodes.rationale: Splits the system prompt at <context> so the static prefix can hit LLM prefix caches, then appends dynamic context as a second system message.

nodes.label: gc_manager GlobalGCManager
nodes.rationale: Runs garbage collection periodically in a thread pool to avoid blocking the asyncio event loop and reduce GIL contention.

nodes.label: voiceprint_provider VoiceprintProvider
nodes.rationale: Caches remote voiceprint health check results via GlobalCacheManager to avoid repeated requests; disables itself when URL, API key, or speakers are invalid.

nodes.label: config CacheConfig
nodes.rationale: Supplies preset CacheConfig per CacheType so callers don't hardcode TTL and size limits.

nodes.label: strategies CacheStrategy
nodes.rationale: Provides TTL, LRU, fixed-size, and combined TTL-LRU eviction strategies to match different data lifetimes and access patterns.

nodes.label: register register_function
nodes.rationale: Uses a module-level all_function_registry so decorators can auto-register functions before FunctionRegistry copies them into a runtime registry.

nodes.label: loadplugins auto_import_modules
nodes.rationale: Auto-imports all modules in a package so @register_function decorators execute and populate the function registry.

nodes.label: PetCollectionCardProperties
nodes.rationale: Spring @ConfigurationProperties bound to pet.collection-card prefix. Provides prototype-specific default collection card pools for 锦鲤 and 玉兔; randomly selects an image URL by concatenating baseUrl + prefix + index + .webp.

nodes.label: PetCollectionCardProperties.Prototype
nodes.rationale: Value object holding OSS base URL, filename prefix, and image count for one pet prototype. hasImage() validates that the pool is usable before random selection.

nodes.label: PetCollectionCardProperties.randomCollectionCardUrl
nodes.rationale: Returns a random collection card URL for a prototype. Falls back to fallbackUrl when config is missing or empty, and to an empty string when fallbackUrl is also unset.

nodes.label: PetServiceImpl
nodes.rationale: Core pet lifecycle service implementing adopt (create egg), birth (device-bound pet), hatch (egg to hatched pet), and daily mood refresh. Uses constructor-injected DAOs, LLMService, AgentService, and property beans.

nodes.label: PetServiceImpl.hatch
nodes.rationale: Transitions a pet from EGG to HATCHED. Computes birth attributes via PetBirthCalculator and LLM-derived MBTI, assigns random gender/bloodType/personalityBrief, sets avatarUrl and collectionCardUrl from configured properties, creates an agent with a rendered system prompt, and registers a virtual wechat-egg-miniprogram device.

nodes.label: PetServiceImpl.randomCollectionCardUrl
nodes.rationale: Private helper that delegates to PetCollectionCardProperties to pick a random default collection card URL for the pet's prototype during hatch.

nodes.label: App onLaunch lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Supports offline demo mode: when config.backendEnabled is false, runtime is set to 'demo' before any backend-dependent operations. Backend bootstrap only proceeds after wx.login returns a valid code and backend is enabled.

nodes.label: Signal Bars
nodes.rationale: Signal strength indicator using 3 levels (1 weak, 2 medium, 3 strong). Business side maps dBm or strength enum to 1-3.

nodes.label: Card
nodes.rationale: General card container with tint variants. Uses externalClasses so pages can override margins/layout despite component style isolation.

nodes.label: Egg Avatar
nodes.rationale: Egg-shaped avatar placeholder using gradient and asymmetric border radius matching the design system --radius-egg token. Converts px size to rpx while preserving 96:112 aspect ratio.

nodes.label: Collapse Item
nodes.rationale: Accordion item reused in two variants: category (help center section headers) and question (Q&A rows). Nested to create a two-level accordion on the help page.

nodes.label: Nav Bar
nodes.rationale: Custom navigation bar that dynamically reads status bar height via wx.getWindowInfo for notch/full-screen compatibility. Defaults to wx.navigateBack but allows custom back behavior via event.

nodes.label: List Row
nodes.rationale: General list row with label, optional value, and chevron. Dispatches custom 'rowtap' event to avoid collision with the native tap event.

nodes.label: Mood Badge
nodes.rationale: Mood badge that maps Chinese mood text to a tone class (positive, calm, longing, low) for styling.

nodes.label: Button
nodes.rationale: Custom button with primary/secondary/danger variants. Pages should register it as 'app-button' to avoid conflict with the native <button> tag.

nodes.label: Switch Row
nodes.rationale: Switch row wrapping the native WeChat switch to retain accessibility semantics and system animation. Dispatches change event with boolean value.

nodes.label: Pet Avatar
nodes.rationale: Pet avatar component rendering a pet type at a configurable size.

nodes.label: EggBabe Design System
nodes.rationale: Design system providing tokens such as --radius-egg and component specifications such as Card.

nodes.label: WeChat Custom Component Pattern
nodes.rationale: WeChat Mini Program Component({}) API for building reusable custom components with properties, data, lifetimes, observers, and methods.

nodes.label: External Classes Mechanism
nodes.rationale: WeChat mechanism that lets page styles override component classes through externalClasses, used because styleIsolation prevents direct page CSS from affecting component internals.

nodes.label: API_BASE_URL
nodes.rationale: Local development backend URL (192.168.4.128:8002/xiaozhi); production domain eggbabe.com is commented out for environment switching.

nodes.label: FONT_FAMILY
nodes.rationale: Matches app.wxss global font-family so canvas-generated share image uses the same typeface as on-screen rendering.

nodes.label: Trusted API origin policy
nodes.rationale: Deployment-time API base must be configured in runtime-config.js; the app refuses to accept an API URL from the page URL to avoid redirecting live card data to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

nodes.label: Card normalization schema
nodes.rationale: Input card objects are normalized into a strict canonical shape with validated enums, date/code patterns, and length limits; collectible cards carry extra required fields and treatment constraints.

nodes.label: Poster 1080x2160 layout grid
nodes.rationale: Fixed 1080x2160 poster canvas with proportional title, illustration, and data sections sized from CARD_HEIGHT constants for consistent share-image output.

nodes.label: Search Tap Handler
nodes.rationale: Placeholder implementation: real FAQ keyword search and highlighting are not yet integrated; currently shows a toast notification.

nodes.label: Contact Customer Service
nodes.rationale: Placeholder customer service configuration: uses hardcoded corpId and kfId values that must be replaced with production credentials before release.
